instruction: Add execute permission for the owner on all regular files under the current directory tree.

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'alt', 't'); time.sleep(0.5)

import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.write('cd testDir'); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.press('enter'); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.write('clear'); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.press('enter')

result.command: cd ~/testDir && if [ $(find . -type f ! -perm /100 | wc -l) -eq 0 ]; then echo 'All files have owner execute permission.'; else echo 'Some files do not have owner execute permission.'; find . -type f ! -perm /100 -exec stat -c '%a %n' {} \;; fi

include: All files have owner execute permission.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully changed all regular file permissions to 644 using 'find . -type f -exec chmod 644 {} +' in 5 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can use terminal, find command with -type and -exec flags, chmod with numeric permissions, navigate directory structure.
metadata.task_rationale: Variation uses symbolic permission (u+x) instead of numeric, testing whether the model can use chmod with symbolic notation to add specific permission bits.
metadata.explanation: Task requires adding owner execute permission to all regular files. Starting permissions: file1.txt=755, file2.txt=644, file3.txt=777. After u+x: 755, 744, 777. Evaluator uses 'find ! -perm /100' to check all files have owner execute bit set.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly uses 'find . -type f ! -perm /100' to identify regular files missing the owner execute bit; -perm /100 tests the owner-execute bit precisely.
Metric check_include_exclude correctly receives the rules dict directly (include/exclude keys) matching the type=rule framework behavior.
Evaluator fully covers the instruction: checks all regular files under the directory tree for owner execute permission.
Working directory 'cd ~/testDir' matches the setup config which places files in testDir.
No UI state dependency; no postconfig needed for a file permission verification task.
